known_false_negative_scope: Only the complete parent oracle_text exact string is matched; face-specific text, alternate capitalization, punctuation, wording, and semantically equivalent text are outside this proposal.
known_false_positive_risk: The complete parent oracle_text must equal exactly "Draw two cards."; this rejects surrounding conditions, modes, triggers, replacements, costs, extra sentences, and suffixes, but does not certify card semantics.
